PROP-01b-partial3-inv-018.text: Reserves must increase proportionally: reservesNew = reserves + interestAccumulated * reserveFactor.
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-018.assertion: forall accrueInterest: totalReserves_post == totalReserves_pre + interestAccumulated * reserveFactor

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-019.text: utilizationRate must be in range [0, 1]: totalBorrows / (cash + totalBorrows).

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-020.text: supplyRate must be <= borrowRate (suppliers earn less due to reserve factor).

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-021.text: collateralFactor must be in range [0, 1] for each market.

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-022.text: Oracle price must be non-zero for all markets used as collateral.
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-022.assertion: forall market m where m.isCollateral: oracle.getPrice(m) > 0

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-023.text: Oracle price must be fresh (within acceptable staleness threshold).
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-023.assertion: forall price_feed pf: current_time - pf.publish_time <= staleness_threshold

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-024.text: cToken transfer must conserve total supply (no tokens created or destroyed).
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-024.assertion: forall transfer(src, dst, amt): totalSupply_post == totalSupply_pre

PROP-01b-partial3-pre-004.text: cToken transfer from must not cause sender shortfall if market is entered.
PROP-01b-partial3-pre-004.assertion: forall transfer(src, dst, amt): src.hasEnteredMarket => getAccountLiquidity(src).shortfall == 0 after

PROP-01b-partial3-asm-001.text: Only admin/governance can list new markets via supportMarket.
PROP-01b-partial3-asm-001.assertion: forall supportMarket(market): caller == admin || caller == governance

PROP-01b-partial3-asm-002.text: New market initial collateralFactor must be 0 until explicitly set by admin.

PROP-01b-partial3-asm-003.text: Market cannot be listed without a valid oracle price feed (price > 0).
PROP-01b-partial3-asm-003.assertion: forall supportMarket(m): oracle.getPrice(m) > 0 at listing time

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-025.text: Flash loan must repay full amount + fee within same transaction or revert.
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-025.assertion: forall flash_loan(user, amt): balance_post >= balance_pre + fee OR tx reverts

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-026.text: Flash loan must not allow collateral manipulation to bypass borrow capacity checks.
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-026.assertion: forall flash_loan(user): borrow_capacity(user) checked AFTER flash_loan callback completes

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-027.text: Oracle price must use confidence interval; reject if confidence > threshold relative to price.

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-028.text: Rounding in mint must be against the user (round down mintTokens).
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-028.assertion: forall mint(user, amt): mintTokens == floor(amt / exchangeRate) (round down)

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-029.text: Rounding in redeem must be against the user (round up redeemTokens for redeemUnderlying).
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-029.assertion: forall redeemUnderlying(user, amt): redeemTokens == ceil(amt / exchangeRate) (round up)

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-030.text: Dust positions must remain liquidatable (no minimum close amount preventing liquidation).
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-030.assertion: forall borrower b: b.shortfall > 0 => exists closeAmount: liquidate(b, closeAmount) succeeds

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-031.text: closeFactor must be in range (0, 1] to prevent zero or over-100% liquidation.

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-032.text: Interest accrual must not overflow: borrowIndex * (1 + rate * blockDelta) within safe bounds.
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-032.assertion: forall accrueInterest: borrowIndex * (1 + borrowRate * blockDelta) <= MAX_U256 AND no overflow

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-033.text: reserveFactor must be in range [0, 1] (cannot extract more than 100% of interest as reserves).

PROP-01b-partial3-post-001.text: After repayBorrowBehalf, funds must be deducted from payer (msg.sender), not borrower.
PROP-01b-partial3-post-001.assertion: forall repayBehalf(payer, borrower, amt): payer.balance decreases AND borrower.borrowBalance decreases

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-034.text: accrueInterest must be called before all state-changing operations (freshness guard).
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-034.assertion: forall op in {mint,redeem,borrow,repay,liquidate}: block.number == accrualBlockNumber before op

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-035.text: When totalSupply == 0, exchangeRate must return initialExchangeRate, not divide by zero.
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-035.assertion: forall market m: m.totalSupply == 0 => exchangeRate(m) == initialExchangeRate

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-036.text: Reserves must never exceed total assets: cash + totalBorrows >= totalReserves.
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-036.assertion: forall market m: getCash(m) + m.totalBorrows >= m.totalReserves

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-037.text: Utilization > 100% must be prevented: totalBorrows cannot exceed cash + totalBorrows.
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-037.assertion: forall market m: m.totalBorrows <= getCash(m) + m.totalBorrows (tautological; enforce getCash >= 0)

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-038.text: Borrow rate must be bounded by max borrow rate to prevent interest rate manipulation DoS.

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-039.text: Flash loan cannot be used to manipulate oracle price within same transaction.
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-039.assertion: forall flash_loan(user): oracle.getPrice uses TWAP or external feed, not spot AMM price

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-040.text: Cascading liquidation must not drain protocol reserves below safe threshold.
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-040.assertion: forall liquidation_sequence: totalReserves >= min_reserve_threshold after all liquidations

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-041.text: accountBorrowNew must not underflow on repay (accountBorrowNew >= 0).

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-042.text: Donation attack: direct underlying transfer to market must not inflate exchange rate for attacker.
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-042.assertion: forall market m: exchangeRate computed from getCash (balance check) not manipulable by donation

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-043.text: E-mode must not allow cross-asset borrowing capacity to exceed safe ratio.
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-043.assertion: forall emode_group g, user u: borrow_value(u, g) <= collateral_value(u, g) * emode_cf(g)

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-044.text: Rate limiter must prevent single-block deposit/withdraw exceeding protocol-configured threshold.
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-044.assertion: forall market m, window w: abs(net_flow(m, w)) <= rate_limit(m)

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-045.text: Reward distribution index must be updated before any position change to prevent stale index exploit.
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-045.assertion: forall position_change(user): reward_index updated BEFORE accountTokens[user] changes

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-046.text: Zero-share deposit must be rejected to prevent share dilution attack.
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-046.assertion: forall mint(user, amt): mintTokens > 0 OR tx reverts

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-047.text: Decimal mismatch between underlying and cToken must be handled consistently in all calculations.
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-047.assertion: forall market m: exchangeRate scaling accounts for (18 - 8 + underlyingDecimals) consistently

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-048.text: ADL (Auto-Deleveraging) must only activate when bad debt exists and must distribute losses fairly.
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-048.assertion: forall adl_event: bad_debt > 0 AND loss_distribution proportional to position_size

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-049.text: Pyth oracle adaptor must validate price confidence and reject stale or low-confidence prices.
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-049.assertion: forall pyth_price p: p.expo normalized AND p.conf/p.price <= threshold AND p.publish_time fresh

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-050.text: Obligation health check must use consistent prices across all collateral and borrow markets in one tx.
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-050.assertion: forall health_check(user): all prices fetched atomically within same oracle snapshot
